name: Alila Villas Uluwatu
positioning: All-villa clifftop resort by WOHA Architects on Bali's Bukit Peninsula, with private pool villas and a cliffside infinity pool
best_for: Couples who want a private pool villa on the cliffs
Travelers interested in sustainable design and Balinese culture

facts.text: The resort is set on a clifftop plateau along the southern coastline of Bali's Bukit Peninsula.
It is an all-villa resort set high on a cliff.
The resort was designed by Singapore-based WOHA Architects to exist in harmony with its natural surroundings.
Villas use locally sourced materials such as lava rock roofs and bamboo ceilings that circulate sea breezes.
Villa guests are looked after by a 24-hour Villa Host service.
The resort has a cliffside infinity pool.
Spa Alila engages local spa therapists who draw on age-old Balinese traditions.
The spa has a steam room and a hammam.
The fitness center includes dedicated yoga and meditation studios.
Guests can take part in interactive experiences in the resort's Sustainability Lab and Organic Garden.
A filtration and bottling system keeps the property plastic-free.
The Warung restaurant serves Indonesian and Balinese flavours.

highlights.text: The Cliff Edge Spa Cabana is perched on the side of the Uluwatu cliff with a view of the Indian Ocean.
The villas feature private pools, cabanas and terraces.
At check-in, guests choose their service style: private, discreet or indulgent.
An Alila Moments day of Balinese spirituality includes sacred cleansing, traditional crafts, temple offerings and a Kecak performance at sunset.
Sunset Cabana Bar serves artisanal cocktails perched over the cliff edge overlooking the Indian Ocean.

considerations.text: The sea is reached by a 600-step cliff-hugging stairway.
Ngurah Rai International Airport is 16.6 kilometers away.
WhataHotel notes the remote clifftop location means transportation is needed to reach beaches and attractions.
